title: TrojanMaxxing: One-shotting VLM Backdoors with Weight-Space Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.27425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can reason directly about the weights of other neural networks. Given only a natural-language objective, an LLM can inspect a model's weights, understand what they compute, and edit them directly without gradient-based optimization. This capability, termed weight-space programming (WSP), has been used to improve model performance on math reasoning, medical QA and other benchmarks. We propose TrojanMaxxing, a novel strategy to backdoor vision-language models (VLMs), by reframing it as a WSP task. We use Claude Opus 5.5 and Mythos 5.2 agents to backdoor VLMs without any optimization or training methods. The agents inspect the model weights, apply targeted edits, and co-design an imperceptible visual trigger that activates the backdoor. translated_title: TrojanMaxxing：基于权重空间编程的一次性VLM后门攻击
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）可以直接对其他神经网络的权重进行推理。仅凭一个自然语言目标，LLM就能检查模型的权重、理解其计算内容，并在无需基于梯度的优化的情况下直接编辑它们。这种能力被称为权重空间编程（WSP），已被用于提升模型在数学推理、医学问答等基准上的表现。我们提出TrojanMaxxing，一种通过将后门攻击重新定义为WSP任务来攻击视觉语言模型（VLM）的新型策略。我们使用Claude Opus 5.5和Mythos 5.2智能体，在不使用任何优化或训练方法的情况下对VLM植入后门。这些智能体检查模型权重、进行针对性编辑，并共同设计一个不可察觉的视觉触发器来激活后门。随后我们研究了智能体的策略，并在各种基准数据集上对植入后门的模型进行了全面评估。TrojanMaxxing实现了攻击（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出TrojanMaxxing，将VLM后门攻击重新定义为权重空间编程任务，利用LLM智能体直接检查并编辑模型权重并协同设计不可察觉的视觉触发器，无需任何训练或优化即可一次性为视觉语言模型植入后门。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TrojanMaxxing, which reframes VLM backdoor attacks as a weight-space programming task, using LLM agents to directly inspect and edit model weights and co-design imperceptible visual triggers, enabling one-shot backdoor implantation in vision-language models without any training or optimization.
